For our client in Merchtem, we are looking for an Inside Sales Representative to develop business across the Middle East and Africa.Our client is an international wholesaler of industrial sealing solutions, supplying technical distributors and industrial trading partners. Its product range includes O-rings, industrial seals and customised sealing products for a wide variety of applications.The company is looking for a commercially driven professional who enjoys approaching potential customers, developing new accounts and turning opportunities into actual sales.This position has a strong business development focus. You will work closely with the External Sales Representative to expand the customer portfolio across the MEA region while continuing to develop relationships with existing clients.What will you do? 
• Actively identify and approach potential B2B customers across the Middle East and Africa. 
• Prospect for new business opportunities and open new customer accounts. 
• Follow up on commercial leads and convert opportunities into sales. 
• Build relationships with new customers and develop long-term business opportunities. 
• Maintain and expand existing customer accounts. 
• Identify opportunities for cross-selling and upselling. 
• Prepare quotations and follow up on commercial proposals. 
• Process orders and respond to customer enquiries. 
• Maintain regular contact with customers by telephone and email. 
• Understand customer requirements and propose suitable sealing solutions. 
• Work closely with the External Sales Representative on commercial activities and customer development. 
• Monitor sales opportunities and report on commercial progress. 
• Provide professional customer service and ensure timely follow-up of requests.
 
• You have a commercial and/or technical background. 
• You have experience in B2B sales and/or customer service. 
• You genuinely enjoy prospecting and approaching new customers. 
• You are confident initiating commercial conversations and following up on opportunities. 
• You are fluent in English and French, both written and spoken. 
• Knowledge of Arabic is an advantage, but not a requirement. 
• Experience with customers in the Middle East or Africa is a plus. 
• Experience selling technical or industrial products is an additional asset. 
• You are comfortable working with Excel and general business software. 
• You communicate clearly and know how to build professional relationships. 
• You take initiative and are motivated by commercial results. 
• You can work independently while maintaining close contact with your sales colleagues. 
• You are customer-oriented, persistent and organised in your approach.

Our client is a leading international insurance company with a strong presence in the Belgian market. Through innovation, customer-centricity, and operational excellence, the organization continuously invests in transforming and growing their Business Units.To support the successful execution of its strategic ambitions, our client is currently looking for a Strategic Change Analyst to join its Brussels-based office.

Jobomschrijving

• Support the definition, structuring and monitoring of the Business Unit strategic roadmap
• Translate strategic priorities into compelling communication materials, executive presentations and impactful storytelling
• Prepare presentations, reports and strategic updates for senior management and executive committees
• Conduct business and strategic analyses to support decision-making and identify growth opportunities
• Perform ad hoc studies related to profitability, operational efficiency, organizational effectiveness and innovation
• Develop recommendations and action plans based on data-driven insights
• Contribute to the optimization and simplification of internal processes across the business unit
• Coordinate and monitor strategic initiatives, transformation projects and change management activities
• Support the annual budgeting process and oversee the monitoring of business unit operating expenses
• Prepare financial analyses, budget forecasts and management reporting
• Collaborate closely with Finance teams on cost allocation, financial planning and performance monitoring
• Act as a key liaison between business stakeholders and Finance to ensure alignment on financial objectives and priorities
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives within budgeting, reporting and governance processes

• Master's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Insurance or a related field
• Minimum 5 years of professional experience in strategy, consulting, business analysis, project management, transformation or change management
• Strong understanding of the Life Insurance sector, including products, regulations and market dynamics
• Experience supporting strategic planning, business transformation and roadmap execution
• Excellent analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable recommendations
• Strong financial acumen with experience in budgeting, financial analysis and management reporting
• Proven ability to create impactful presentations and deliver effective executive-level storytelling
• Experience in process improvement and cross-functional project coordination
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across multiple business functions
• Highly organized, autonomous and capable of challenging assumptions in a constructive manner
• Ability to synthesize complex information and present clear conclusions to management
• Fluency in French/Dutch and English, both written and spoken.

Our client is a well-established company operating within an international environment. Known for its customer-focused approach and operational excellence, the company is looking to strengthen its Supply Chain department with a motivated and detail-oriented Purchasing & Supply Chain Officer.This role offers the opportunity to work closely with suppliers, sales teams, and supply chain professionals while contributing to the smooth flow of daily operations.

Jobomschrijving

As a Purchasing & Supply Chain Officer, you will provide key administrative support to the purchasing and supply chain teams and help ensure an efficient and reliable supply process.Your responsibilities include:

• Processing and monitoring purchase orders and supplier information
• Following up on delivery schedules and supplier commitments
• Ensuring accurate data management within the ERP system
• Identifying and reporting supply-related issues or discrepancies
• Supporting Supply Chain Planners with backorders and ongoing deliveries
• Assisting the sales team with product availability and lead-time inquiries
• Maintaining smooth communication between suppliers and internal departments
• Contributing to the continuous improvement of supply chain processes

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience
• Initial experience in purchasing, supply chain, logistics administration or a similar role
• Fluent in Dutch with a good professional knowledge of French and English
• Experience working with ERP systems
• Good Excel skills
• Strong organizational and administrative abilities
• Accurate, structured and detail-oriented
• Proactive and solution-driven mindset
• Excellent communication and teamwork skills

Our client is a leading international retail organization operating across multiple countries. This company is investing heavily in the modernization and optimization of its technology landscape, with SAP playing a central role in supporting business operations and future growth.As part of its ongoing digital transformation journey, the organization is strengthening its SAP Retail team to enhance business processes, improve operational efficiency, and support strategic initiatives across procurement, supply chain, inventory management, pricing, and store operations.As Senior SAP Retail Specialist, you will join a team of experienced professionals working closely with stakeholders across business and IT functions to deliver impactful solutions that support the organization's long-term ambitions.

Jobomschrijving

As Senior SAP Retail Specialist, you will be responsible for supporting, optimizing, and evolving SAP Retail solutions across the end-to-end retail value chain.Your key responsibilities will include:

• Supporting and enhancing SAP Retail business processes across procurement, inventory management, assortment management, pricing, replenishment, logistics, and store operations.
• Gathering business requirements and translating them into functional specifications and effective SAP solutions.
• Configuring SAP Retail functionalities and ensuring alignment with SAP best practices.
• Driving process standardization and continuous improvement initiatives across business units and countries.
• Providing 2nd and 3rd line functional support, investigating incidents, identifying root causes, and coordinating issue resolution.
• Contributing to SAP transformation and S/4HANA-related projects by participating in workshops, solution design activities, testing, and deployment initiatives.
• Collaborating with business users, project teams, implementation partners, and external service providers.
• Supporting system integrations with eCommerce platforms, warehouse management solutions, financial applications, POS systems, EDI interfaces, and other third-party solutions.
• Assisting data migration activities and promoting data quality and governance best practices.
• Acting as a trusted advisor for business stakeholders while mentoring junior team members and facilitating knowledge transfer.
• Ensuring the stability, performance, and long-term sustainability of SAP Retail solutions

To succeed in this role, you will combine strong SAP Retail expertise with excellent stakeholder management and problem-solving capabilities.You ideally bring:

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Supply Chain, or a related field.
• At least 8 years of SAP experience, including a minimum of 5 years focused on SAP Retail.
• Proven experience working within large-scale retail organizations and complex international environments.
• Strong expertise in:
• SAP Retail
• SAP MM
• SAP SD
• Assortment Management
• Article Master Data
• Purchasing Processes
• Inventory Management
• Invoice Verification
• Retail Pricing
• Exposure to SAP S/4HANA Retail, SAP CAR, SAP Datasphere, SAP BTP, or SAP Integration Suite would be considered a strong advantage.
• Solid understanding of retail and supply chain business processes.
• Experience in solution design, requirements gathering, testing, and change management.
• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
• Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities.
• The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
• Fluency in English and either French or Dutch.

jobs.occupation: Executive Assistant to VP - Zaventem - Medical Industry
jobs.description:
Our client is an international medical technology company dedicated to improving patient outcomes through innovative, clinically proven solutions in key areas of care. They believe that ideas can come from anywhere, and they encourage employees at every level to make a difference.

Jobomschrijving

Provide full administrative support to the VP, including calendar management, prioritization of meetings, screening calls and emails, and coordinating daily tasks.Prepare executive summaries, meeting pre-reads, and contract materials to ensure the VP is well-informed for all engagements.Manage budgets, vendor selection, contract negotiation, and on-site logistics for off-site meetings and conferences in coordination with procurement.Oversee business travel and visa arrangements, and ensure timely, accurate submission of expense reports.Create polished PowerPoint presentations, respond professionally to internal and external inquiries, and maintain discretion with sensitive information.Build and maintain strong relationships with global and external stakeholders, support strategic meetings, training, events, and team-building activities across Europe.Develop robust knowledge of the business's structure, tools, policies, and key contacts, support sensitive employee matters, and ensure completion of required training.

jobs.occupation: iDSB - International German School Brussels - Head of IT Coordination & Administration
jobs.description:
The purpose of this position is to ensure the daily operation, proper maintenance and development of information and communication systems in order to support a high-quality edcuation and an efficient administration of the school. This role becomes more important over time. A high quality IT infrastructure and very good user experience are distinction criteria for the school and therefore a leverage to reach our strategic long term objectives.

The position holder on the one hand needs to be capable of supporting the school staff with a clientoriented mindset on all IT related issues. On the other hand she/he needs to proactively advise on improvements of the IT Infrastructure, support the decision making process and implement such new solutions.
Your tasks (list is not exhaustive)

• Responsible for the daily operation of the School's Information- and Communication Infrastructure

• Maintenance of all Hard- and Software components used in the school (Server, Antivirus, Backups, wired and wireless networks, Firewalls, video conference equipment, endpoints, telephony).

• Ensure the security of all IT systems (apply security patches, manage configurations, ensure Anti-virus and other security updates)

• Ensure all required IT services are available during school hours (7:30 - 17:30) and on request also outside school hours through pro-active maintenance and SWIFT and effective troubleshooting

• Manage the school provided Mobile devices (laptops, tablets, smartphones, mobile phones)

• Management of Contracts: Software Licenses, Maintenance agreements, IT related leasing

• Installation of new systems (including testing, appropriate communication, training etc.)

• Assure connection to external specialists and leverage them as appropriate for the school

• User access Management (including setting up accounts for new users etc.)

• Creation and maintenance of complete documentation of all ICT systems (e.g. network structure, security architecture, overview of servers in operation, network components, end devices such as PCs, tablets, projectors, smartboards, monitors, ...)

• Proactively advise on system changes or new products, which could improve the IT landscape of the school, both in the area of software as well as Hardware

• Monitor and actively advise on developments in the educational environment (Germany, Belgium) as far as Technology in schools is concerned

• Act as an advisor on general IT topics for the school's headmaster and the administrative board

Organization / exposure

• The jobholder reports to the Head of Administration of the School.

• The position is complemented by a junior IT expert, who would report to the jobholder.

• Day-to-day contact with Teachers, administrative staff and students. Occasional contact with external stakeholders (Parents, Administration Board).

• Motivated IT allrounder with 3-5 years relevant experience

• Expertise in providing 1st Level support for a small to medium organization

• Expertise in Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Windows 10 and network technology

• Experience with selection and implementation of new hard- or software.

• Able to communicate with partners with limited IT background when proposing new solutions or changes to existing solutions

• Ideally some project management experience

• Proactivity - you find issues before they find you, eager to push things forward

• Problem Solving Skills

• Hands-on activities are your thing

• Client oriented mindset; self-organized but also a teamplayer

• Ability to prioritise; Adherence to deadlines

• Languages: solid knowledge of English; basic German; French and / or Dutch desirable but not mandatory

jobs.occupation: Technical Safety Officer Maritime Operations - EN
jobs.description:
• Be present on the yard and on board vessels on a daily basis to monitor activities, risks and safety measures. 

• Carry out safety rounds, inspections and audits to identify unsafe situations and technical risks, and quickly implement the necessary corrective actions. 

• Address and raise awareness among employees and subcontractors, and ensure safety rules are applied correctly. 

• Prepare, update and follow up risk assessments, safety procedures and action points. 

• Monitor safety during maintenance and repair activities, including the safe isolation of work areas and technical installations. 

• Provide practical safety advice and discuss improvement points with Superintendents, technical staff, naval personnel, subcontractors and other stakeholders. 

• Ensure proper administrative follow-up and reporting on safety and prevention.  

#ontmoetingsdag

 

• Strong technical background in shipping, marine engineering, industry, maintenance or complex technical worksites. 

• Experience as, for example, a Superintendent, maritime Project Manager, Engineer, Technical Specialist or in an operational role on board is a strong foundation. 

• Good technical understanding of areas such as mechanics, electricity, hydraulics, maintenance activities, working at height, heavy loads and technical spaces. 

• Strong interest in safety and prevention; previous experience in a formal safety role is not required. 

• Strong communication skills, a practical mindset and the ability to engage people clearly and convincingly in safe working practices. 

• Natural authority, assertiveness and, above all, a genuine passion for making safety visible and intervening when necessary. 

• Flexible, approachable and willing to spend most of your time on the work floor. 

• Good command of English; knowledge of Dutch and French is an advantage.

Inetum is a European leader in digital services. Every day, the Group's 28,000 consultants and specialists aim to make a digital impact for businesses, public sector bodies and society as a whole: solutions that contribute to performance, innovation and the common good.

Present in 19 countries, close to the regions, and with its major software publisher partners, Inetum meets the challenges of digital transformation with proximity and flexibility.

In response to a market that has been growing steadily for over 30 years, Inetum has made the deliberate choice to refocus on 4 core businesses in order to gain strength and offer customized solutions tailored to the specific needs of its customers: consulting (Inetum Consulting), infrastructure and application management (Inetum Technologies), software implementation (Inetum Solutions) and its own software publishing business (Inetum Software). Inetum has forged strategic partnerships with 4 of the world's leading software publishers - Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft and SAP - and is pursuing a dedicated acquisition strategy to become one of Europe's top 5 in these technologies, and offer the best expertise to its customers.

Organisation

Inetum Consulting is a strategy and transformation consulting firm part of the Inetum group. With a team of 450 multidisciplinary consultants, we are present in Europe (France, Spain, Portugal, Belgium) and Africa (Morocco).

Inetum Consulting supports companies and public organizations in their strategic projects through five major offerings: CIO Advisory, Sustainability, Data & GenAI, Transformation & Change, Corporate Functions Advisory.

Guided by a sector-specific consulting approach enriched by innovation and technological solutions, we help our customers steer their transformation towards sustainable performance and a more resilient, responsible society.

We value a unique and strong corporate culture, imbued with the values of excellence, which contributes significantly to the success of organizations.

At inetum consulting, we offer more than just a job; we provide an inspiring environment and opportunities for growth and development. we strive to create a workplace where you can harness your talents, contribute to challenging projects, and be part of a leading IT consultancy group.

Job description

To support the growth of Inetum Consulting in Belgium, we are hiring a Business Analyst to reinforce our teams delivering transformation projects in the following ecosystems: Energy & Utilities, Supply Chain & Manufacturing, Public, and Healthcare. You will contribute to both client missions and internal initiatives that accelerate the growth of our consulting unit and strengthen our sector offerings.

We are looking for someone with a proven track record in delivering mid-to-large scale digital and transformation projects, who takes ownership, is eager to learn, and thrives in an environment that combines client impact with entrepreneurial team growth.

Your responsibilities

 
• You will lead and deliver consulting assignments, including:
  
   
• Data analysis, benchmarks, stakeholder interviews, and insight synthesis
   
• Workshop facilitation and workshop animation with client stakeholders
   
• Process mapping, business analysis, and definition of implementation roadmaps
   
• Supporting (or leading) project workstreams as part of major digital transformation programs
    
  
 
• You will contribute to a broad range of transformation topics, such as:
  
   
• Projects to improve operational performance
   
• Strategic framing and optimization of business processes
   
• Master plan definition and implementation...
  
...

• Master's degree (engineering or business school)

• Minimum 2 years of professional experience, including previous experience in a consulting firm (strategy, transformation, operations excellence, or digital consulting)

• Have experience in process modelling (BPMN)

• Demonstrated experience delivering cross-functional improvement or transformation projects

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills; able to manage project teams and engage senior client stakeholders

• Interest in ERP tools or other sector related technologies is considered a plus

• Fluent in English and fluent in either Dutch or French with professional working proficiency in the other language

• Entrepreneurial mindset and motivation to collaborate and grow within the Inetum Consulting team

jobs.occupation: Inetum - Business Consultant Manufacturing & Supply Chain
jobs.description:
Inetum is a European leader in digital services. Every day, the Group's 28,000 consultants and specialists aim to make a digital impact for businesses, public sector bodies and society as a whole: solutions that contribute to performance, innovation and the common good.

Present in 19 countries, close to the regions, and with its major software publisher partners, Inetum meets the challenges of digital transformation with proximity and flexibility.

In response to a market that has been growing steadily for over 30 years, Inetum has made the deliberate choice to refocus on 4 core businesses in order to gain strength and offer customized solutions tailored to the specific needs of its customers: consulting (Inetum Consulting), infrastructure and application management (Inetum Technologies), software implementation (Inetum Solutions) and its own software publishing business (Inetum Software). Inetum has forged strategic partnerships with 4 of the world's leading software publishers - Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft and SAP - and is pursuing a dedicated acquisition strategy to become one of Europe's top 5 in these technologies, and offer the best expertise to its customers.

Inetum Consulting is a strategy and transformation consulting firm part of the Inetum group. With a team of 450 multidisciplinary consultants, we are present in Europe (France, Spain, Portugal, Belgium) and Africa (Morocco).

Inetum Consulting supports companies and public organizations in their strategic projects through five major offerings: CIO Advisory, Sustainability, Data & GenAI, Transformation & Change, Corporate Functions Advisory.

Guided by a sector-specific consulting approach enriched by innovation and technological solutions, we help our customers steer their transformation towards sustainable performance and a more resilient, responsible society.

We value a unique and strong corporate culture, imbued with the values of excellence, which contributes significantly to the success of organizations.

At inetum consulting, we offer more than just a job; we provide an inspiring environment and opportunities for growth and development. we strive to create a workplace where you can harness your talents, contribute to challenging projects, and be part of a leading IT consultancy group.

Job Description

 
• As part of the development of the Industry sector team with a focus on manufacturing & supply chain, we are looking to strengthen the team.
 
• You will participate in on both client activities as internal activities supporting the growth of our Industry sector team within Inetum Consulting:
  
   
• We are interested in people with proven track records in delivering mid-large scale digital projects linked to manufacturing & supply chain topics.
   
• We believe in people we hire, we encourage people to take ownership by given them the right support, environment and tools to be successful at Inetum.
  
 
• You will execute & leading project assignments, including, data analysis, benchmarks, interviews, workshop animation, process mapping, business analysis, implementation roadmaps etc.
 
• Following the assignment, you will take up team lead roles.
 
• You will get the opportunity to contribute actively within the Industry Sector team to support the growth, expand our offering in manufacturing and supply chain and participate to seminars, publications,....
 
• Equipped with the entrepreneurial fibre, you are ready to collaborate within the Inetum Consulting global business line:
  
   
• Carrying out projects to improve operational performance
   
• Assisting the project owner or Program Manager on major digital transformation programmes
   
• Strategic framing and optimisation...
  
...

• You have at least 3 years of experience in the manufacturing or supply chain industry gained within a consulting firm focused on Operations Excellence.

• You have actively participated in cross-functional projects to improve operational excellence.

• Your ability to propose solutions enables you to assert yourself on high-value-added business topics with Industrial and General Management.

• You are fluent in Dutch or French and English and proficient in Dutch or French at least professionally, allowing you to conduct workshops in an international environment.
